source.label: Gottlieb Snow Queen factory instruction cards

strategy.overview: Snow Queen and Snow Derby turn playfield scoring into lap advances and an end-of-ball lap award. Every 10 points adds one advance, every 50 adds five, and 10 advances complete a lap. Shoot the two spinners up the sides, nudge upper action toward lit saucers, and protect the late balls because their lap value can rise from 50 to 100 and 200.
strategy.simpleOverview: In Snow Queen or Snow Derby, shoot the side spinners and keep the ball in the upper bumpers. Every 10 points adds one advance; 10 advances make a lap. Favor lit top saucers, especially on the last two balls when the installed five-ball setup can double and then quadruple the 50-point lap value.
strategy.summary: Build laps through repeated spinner rotations and upper-playfield scoring, then preserve the end-of-ball collect. Late-ball lap value can outweigh early scoring, so favor a controllable side shot and a safe lit-saucer rebound over direct bumper contact.

quickInfo.name: Advances
quickInfo.summary: Every 10 playfield points adds one advance; a 50-point switch adds five.

quickInfo.name: Laps
quickInfo.summary: Every 10 advances completes one lap, up to the installed maximum.

quickInfo.name: Lap collect
quickInfo.summary: Completed laps score when the ball ends; do not tilt away the collect.

quickInfo.name: Late-ball value
quickInfo.summary: On the five-ball Snow Derby schedule, laps score 100 each on ball four and 200 each on ball five.

steps.text: Plunge for a top lane or lit saucer that keeps the ball among the bumpers.
Shoot either side spinner and aim through it rather than directly into a bumper face.
Use gentle nudges to turn upper rebounds into another spinner pass or a lit saucer entry.
On later balls, repeat the safest spinner route and avoid lower-risk detours that threaten the built lap collect.
Ease off the cabinet before the drain so the completed laps score at end of ball.
Use spinners and 50-point features to add advances quickly.
Convert each 10 advances into a lap.
Protect the ball and collect the installed late-ball lap value.

machineSetup: Identify Snow Queen versus two-player Snow Derby, confirm three- or five-ball play, lap maximum, and the per-ball lap values shown by the installed feature adjustment.
Test both spinners, the rotating rollunder target, all top saucers and kickouts, advance and lap units, late-ball value lamps, bumpers, end-of-ball collect, and tilt behavior.
